title: ACadSharp modeler read/write scope and linked-PR audit
mode: primary-source web and GitHub API review; plan-only update
scope: Trace ACadSharp ACIS/modeler reader and writer claims to merged changes, current PR status, exact changed files, and test type
Reconcile the linked writer proposals with the reported DXF silent-loss issue
Refine the existing local evidence gates without adding per-slice validation cost

method.kind: Read current upstream issue/PR pages, PR metadata, changed-file lists and patches; reconcile with existing local plans and research receipts
method.limitations: ACadSharp issue counts and the #1139 large-corpus extraction totals are contributor-reported and were not reproduced. Open PR patches were inspected, not built or run. PR status and mutable project documentation can change; the recorded states are the GitHub snapshot accessed 2026-10-18. No external/customer drawing was used, and no local implementation behavior was tested in this research pass.

sources.observed: The change adds raw ACIS payload extraction from legacy DXF group 1/3, DWG modeler streams, and R2013+ AcDs/ACDSDATA paths. The contributor reports 306 files and over 16,000 extracted payloads, with a known multi-blob gap. The PR describes read-only carrier extraction; it does not claim SAT/SAB B-rep interpretation or independent analytic geometry validation.

sources.revision: Open, unmerged; head 098d7a3a7ce84101e2391ce965fc4138d1b35e54; last substantive activity reviewed 2026-10-01
sources.observed: The proposal changes DXF and DWG writers and adds a Prototype1b/AcDs writer. Its tests include same-library Prototype1b readback; one manually parsed search-index test covers permuted handle order. The maintainer says the raw DataStorage writer loses schema information needed for future use and prefers a generic schema-aware writer. Follow-up comments identify a rebase conflict after the Prototype1b refactor and a multi-group-310 DXF readback issue. The branch is an unmerged implementation proposal, not released capability or an independent oracle.

sources.revision: PR #1240 open and non-mergeable at access; head 9535336162a79a6bd06b444d4b3577918b039ec8; base 12f836af8cd7b470ee6883a9ccc51a22dee66e24; depends on #1174
sources.observed: The changed-file list contains only DWG object-writer files, not DXF writer code. The inspected patch refuses pre-R2013 binary SAB by warning and emitting an empty ACIS body; it adds no AcDs section writer in this change. Thus the linked PR title does not establish a fix for the DXF writer loss report or complete cross-version SAT/SAB/AcDs writing.

The reporter describes ACadSharp 3.4.9 omitting 3DSOLID/REGION entities during DWG-to-DXF conversion, including solids that were the sole contents of blocks. Counts were cross-checked by the reporter with LibreDWG. The customer files are not attached, so this is a real-world failure report and test-shape lead, not a reproduced peer result or local libdxfrw defect.

FreeCAD documents that its stock DXF import cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids and that DWG import uses an external converter to DXF before the chosen DXF importer. This route is not an ACIS semantic consumer.

The issue reports a separate loss of R2013+ ACIS payloads carried in AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b. It reinforces the need to separate modeler entity shells, AcDs payload transport/ownership, and solid semantics; it is not a local defect finding.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies ACadSharp evidence by exact implementation direction and changed-file scope. The merged reader is raw-carrier extraction; #1150 is an unmerged cross-format writer proposal with schema-design and rebase/readback concerns; linked #1240 is a DWG-only writer patch and does not fix the DXF omission report. Reuse existing per-entity disposition, block/INSERT closure, AcDs linkage, and composed independent semantic/native gates. No new local work item or per-slice validation prerequisite is justified.

implementationReadyChecks: Inspect current merge/release state, exact base/head, changed files, version/format scope, and test oracle before treating a linked PR as a resolved issue.
Keep raw carrier extraction and byte preservation separate from ACIS parsing, valid closed-solid semantics, analytic expectations, and native consumer acceptance.
Retain generated fast controls for entity identity, group-1/3 and group-310 framing, sentinels, AcDs ownership, and block/INSERT closure; do not add peer/customer DWG or DXF files.
For unsupported modeler entities, require an explicit diagnostic/refusal and destination-preservation behavior instead of silent omission or empty blocks.
Keep peer installs, full suites, and native applications at existing composed checkpoints; no new per-slice dependency or validation lane is introduced.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; peer status, raw-byte extraction, and issue reports cannot promote support claims.
